scope.existing_product_server_8080: do not contact, stop, or reconfigure
scope.primary: matched-deterministic: temp=0, top_p=1, top_k=0, min_p=0, presence_penalty=0, repetition_penalty=1
scope.sensitivity: official Bonsai non-thinking profile, same request and server values for both models: temp=0.7, top_p=0.80, top_k=20, min_p=0, presence_penalty=1.5, repetition_penalty=1, enable_thinking=false
scope.sensitivity_repeats: 3 independent sequential runs per model on the same full frozen 48 cases; every run has a unique report/log label
scope.determinism_check: one additional 12-case re-run per model at matched-deterministic settings; full primary run remains 48 cases
scope.inference_order: one model process at a time: primary Qwen then Bonsai; deterministic 12-case repeat Qwen then Bonsai; official sensitivity rep1 Qwen then Bonsai, rep2 Qwen then Bonsai, rep3 Qwen then Bonsai

primary_outputs: accepted text after existing local corrections and same-model meaning verifier
paired per-case CER and character exact match
paired WER and exact match over normalized content tokens
content-error-only WER and token-exact scores on cases whose baseline has token errors
scoring.synthetic_lexical_corrections: Corpus includes at least 16 contextually specified ASR-like lexical substitutions; actual baseline content-error subset is automatically determined by normalized-token WER > 0 and is reported from scorer output.
scoring.content_tokens: llm._words normalized tokens (casefolded, diacritics and punctuation ignored); WER is Levenshtein word edits divided by reference token count. Content-error subset is fixed per case by baseline WER > 0.
scoring.numeric_gate_note: Production preserves spelled numbers as well as their values (e.g. cien -> 100 is rejected); do not treat numeric-format conversion as an eligible gold correction. Numeric and technical references retain the input's spoken number forms where applicable. Report candidate/proposal behavior separately from accepted output; verifier-gated outcomes are the operative comparison.
scoring.verifier_parameters: Candidate requests send all selected profile values. The same-model verifier request explicitly sends temperature=0, enable_thinking=false, max_tokens=8; it does not send top_p/top_k/min_p/presence_penalty/repetition_penalty, so those are inherited from the identical per-profile server launch flags. Reports must distinguish verifier from candidate sampling.

acceptance_rule.winner: Declare no winner if either model has any critical-invariant violation or any no-change lexical edit. For the same model to win, paired 95% case-bootstrap confidence intervals (10,000 resamples, fixed seed 211) must exclude zero in the favorable direction for all of: mean CER difference, character exact-match-rate difference, normalized-token WER difference, and normalized-token exact-match-rate difference, both over all cases and over the fixed baseline-content-error subset. Content benefit is mandatory; punctuation/capitalization/formatting gains alone cannot win. Harmful lexical-edit count must not be worse. The full 48-case matched-deterministic result and all three official-sampler full-corpus repeats must support the same winner direction; if the directions cross, any required interval includes a tie, or a repeat is inconsistent, declare inconclusive. Never infer real-world Parakeet efficacy from synthetic cases.
acceptance_rule.uncertainty: Use paired case bootstrap for each per-case difference; report all paired rows, three full-corpus official-sampler repeats and between-repeat variation. If the content-error subset is too small for a stable interval, explicitly call inconclusive.

limitations: All cases are synthetic and authored; no audio or user data is used.
This does not measure ASR output quality or real-world Parakeet correction efficacy.
The same-model meaning verifier can reject genuine number-format changes; that protection remains in the operational path and is not bypassed for scoring.
